title: Who provides each mod id
description: data/providers.json: each mod id the listing's repositories claim, with its claimants in the order ender weighs them, so a launcher places a mod's dependencies without fetching search.json. A claimant is trusted when it is established (50 stars or more), shares an owner with the mod requiring it, or is marked author; ender takes the first trusted one whose targets fit the instance. Fields may be added at any time.

author.description: True when its author keeps an established repository whose mods it names, as ender trusts it

targets.description: The loaders and game versions it has releases for, as search.json's targets

established.description: True when it has 50 stars or more, as ender trusts it

ids.description: A mod id to its claimants, as positions in repositories, in the order ender weighs them
